description: Land Acquisition - Wadurawa, Mottunna and Thalgasmote, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels totaling 8.2851 hectares. It contains detailed descriptions of individual land lots, their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related administrative actions.
